idea-plugin.name: o2commit
idea-plugin.description:
Generate Git commit messages with the claude / codex CLI already installed on your machine. No API key, no proxy setup — o2commit reuses your local, logged-in AI CLI instead of calling any LLM API directly. It reads your staged changes, builds a prompt, runs the local CLI, and fills the result back into the commit message field. Just click the "✨ Generate Commit Message" button in the commit panel.

使用本地已登录的 claude / codex CLI 自动生成 Git 提交信息。
无需 API Key、无需配置网络代理 —— 直接复用你机器上装好的 AI CLI。
在提交面板点击「✨ 生成提交信息」按钮即可。
